about: The preflight record of Abstraction ladder study 2: the go or no-go thresholds and the decision-L gate of docs/STUDY-2-DESIGN.md (Preflight steps), with one slot per step. preflight.py report fills the measured parts from the step records; the judgement of the gate and the go or no-go decision stay the lead developer's.

thresholds.text: Host free memory never under 6 GiB during the soak
No OOM kill and no unplanned restart
Every reference solution matches the key
The decision-L gate is passed: no unexplained discrepancy between the real service and the simulator

steps.title: Inventory
steps.needs: the lead developer's go for the step; building the service image is a separate operator step

steps.title: Oracle alone
steps.needs: Oracle provisioned or started by the operator with missions_operator.py, after the lead developer's environment go

steps.title: Data
steps.needs: the reset to release 1.2 and the read-only service login, both operator steps with the lead developer's go

steps.title: The Missions service on 127.0.0.1:8083
steps.needs: the service started by the operator with its compose file; the simulator recorded the same way in the simulated mode; then compare

steps.title: The whole stack, per arm
steps.needs: the scenario's stack started with study/launch/launch.py up; the acceptance list A and the adapter gates run by the operator with their own commands

steps.title: Outage mechanics
steps.needs: the scenario's stack up; the lead developer's go, because the step stops and starts services through study/launch/launch.py

steps.title: Answerability
steps.needs: corpus 2 and its reference solutions: a later Job

steps.title: Provenance
steps.needs: the study config written by study/launch/make_config.py and the scenario's stack up

steps.title: Paid smoke test
steps.needs: corpus 2 and the lead developer's go for paid requests: a later Job

questions: Does it affect the tool behaviour?
Does it affect the guide's accuracy?
Does it affect the answerability of tasks?
Does it affect the expected answers?
procedure: Classify each difference first, against the five questions.
Record it in the preflight record, with its evidence.
Fix any affected setup: the tool configuration, the guide (through its independent check, decision J), the reference solutions or the answer key.
Run the relevant Direct Access and Guided Direct Access smoke checks again.
An unexplained discrepancy blocks the freeze. It is not carried into scored execution.
decisionL.note: Expected latency differences are documented; the real service is not made to imitate the simulator.

onFailureOptions: a larger Docker share (the lead developer's setting)
only the running arm's router (already the case)
a lower Oracle memory pin (a governed change of the reviewed environment)
